# Generated code - do not edit

`ApexPostApiClient.g.cs` is written by NSwag from `contracts/v2.json` using `ApexPost.Client/nswag.json`.
Building `ApexPost.Client` regenerates it automatically when either input changes. Hand edits are lost.
Add behaviour in `ApexPost.Client/ApexPostApiClient.Extensions.cs` (partial class) or a wrapper instead.
